name: Amangons
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Amangons is a king of Arthurian legend. He brings the quest for the Grail about because of his shame. He and his men broke the maidens who guarded the sacred wells in the deep forest of Britain. With the keepers harmed, the land grew waste. So the quest for the Grail began to heal the hurt.

key_results: Show the crime and the quest it sets.
